subject: System Design
title: Uber's Matching System
description: A quick win: understand Uber's Matching System.

hook.text: You request a ride. In seconds, a driver 3 minutes away accepts. Matching riders to drivers is a real-time optimization.

buildup.text: Uber's matching considers distance, ETA, driver rating, ride type, and current demand in real time.

discovery.text: Geospatial indexing divides the map into cells. Only drivers in nearby cells are considered, reducing the search space.

twist.text: Uber moved from first-dispatch (nearest driver) to batched matching — waiting seconds finds better global matches.

climax.text: Uber's matching runs millions of optimizations per second across hundreds of cities simultaneously.

punchline.text: Wait a few seconds, match globally — better than instant greedy matching.

quiz.question: Why did Uber switch to batched matching?
options: Waiting a few seconds finds better overall matches than picking the nearest driver instantly
